aiMetadata.description: Fetches the parsed/extracted structured data and metadata for one already-processed Airparser document, identified by its inbox and document ID. Use after a document has finished parsing to read back the extracted fields. Read-only and idempotent; repeating the call returns the same result.

upload_document.name: upload_document
upload_document.description: Upload a document to an Airparser inbox for parsing.

auth.description: You can find your API key in the Airparser dashboard under Account Settings.

file.description: The document file to upload for parsing.

meta.description: Optional metadata to associate with the document.

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a file to a specified Airparser inbox so it can be parsed into structured data; requires the inbox ID and the file. Use to submit a new document (PDF, email, image, etc.) for extraction. Not idempotent: each call creates a new document, and parsing completes asynchronously, so retrieve the results separately once parsing finishes.

markdown.description:
## Airparser Webhook Setup
			To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your Airparser account:

			1. Login to your Airparser account.
			2. Navigate to **Integrations** > **Webhooks** in the left sidebar.
			3. Enter the following URL in the webhooks field and select **Document Parsed** as webhook trigger:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Click Save to register the webhook.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Airparser finishes parsing a document in the selected inbox (the doc.parsed event), signaling that extracted data is ready to retrieve. Requires a webhook to be configured manually in the Airparser account.

de.## Airparser Webhook Setup\n\t\t\tTo use:
## Airparser Webhook Setup
			Um diesen Trigger nutzen zu können, müssen Sie manuell einen Webhook in Ihrem Airparser-Konto einrichten:

			1. Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem Airparser-Konto an.
			2. Navigieren Sie zu **Integrations** > **Webhooks** in der linken Seitenleiste.
			3. Geben Sie die folgende URL im Webhooks Feld ein und wählen Sie **Document Parsed** als Webhook Trigger aus:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Klicken Sie auf Speichern, um den Webhook zu registrieren.

fr.## Airparser Webhook Setup\n\t\t\tTo use:
## Configuration du Webhook Airparser
			Pour utiliser ce déclencheur, vous devez configurer manuellement un webhook dans votre compte Airparser :

			1. Connectez-vous à votre compte Airparser.
			2. Accédez à **Intégrations** > **Webhooks** dans la barre latérale gauche.
			3. Entrez l'URL suivante dans le champ Webhooks et sélectionnez **Document Parsed** comme déclencheur de webhook :
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Cliquez sur Enregistrer pour enregistrer le webhook.

es.## Airparser Webhook Setup\n\t\t\tTo use:
## Configuración de Airparser Webhook
			Para utilizar este disparador, necesita configurar manualmente un webhook en su cuenta de Airparser:

			1. Inicia sesión en tu cuenta de Airparser.
			2. Navega a **Integraciones** > **Webhooks** en la barra lateral izquierda.
			3. Introduzca la siguiente URL en el campo webhooks y seleccione **Documento Analizado** como activador de webhook:
			```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```
			4. Haga clic en Guardar para registrar el webhook.
